title: Banned Domains
subtitle: Hostnames that no customer may add to this server.

add.title: Add to the list
add.domainsHint: One per line, or separated by commas. A name that is not a valid hostname is reported back and not stored.
add.matchSubdomainsHint: Left on, a ban on example.com also refuses login.example.com. A phishing name is usually one label down.

remove.title: Remove from the list
remove.message: {{domain}} will be accepted again. Domains that already exist are not affected either way.

errors.loadFailed: The list could not be loaded
errors.saveFailed: The list could not be written

footnote: The list is checked when a domain, addon domain or subdomain is created, and during a site migration. Adding a name here does not take an existing site down and does not stop its certificate from renewing; removing a domain is a separate action.
